quote.text: The knowledge of what is mine and what is not mine, what I can and cannot do. I must die. But must I die bawling? I must be exiled; but is there anything to keep me from going with a smile, calm and self-composed?
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize the value of discernment: Understand which emotions and events (like a child's challenging behavior) are within your control, cultivating a mindful and calm response.
    • Instill resilience by leading by example; showing your children that facing life's inevitable trials with a composed smile nurtures inner strength and balance.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace responsibility by clearly distinguishing between what you can influence and what lies beyond your reach, empowering you to lead with clarity and purpose.
    • Cultivate a steady demeanor in the face of adversity; even when circumstances seem relentless, a calm, self-composed attitude inspires trust and motivates your team.
  • Product Management
    • Focus on controllable factors: Identify which aspects of your product and its development are truly yours to shape, allowing you to prioritize wisely and reduce unnecessary stress.
    • Adopt a mindset of composure during setbacks; when faced with unavoidable challenges or market changes, channel calm determination to pivot, learn, and improve your product strategy.
